plugins.name: skill-review
plugins.description: Quick AI reviewer for Agent Skills: checks structure, workflow, references, and links. Clear report without jargon, with a summary from an exhausted data scientist.

plugins.name: mindbox
plugins.description: Build marketing scenarios, audience filters and emails in a Mindbox project from plain-language requests: flow-create designs and fills a scenario, filter-build builds a platform-confirmed filter, filter-explain reads one back in business terms, email writes an email layout and email-ops previews it, saves it into a campaign and edits the campaign. Nothing is launched or sent to customers, and no filter is saved as a segment.
